title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: the 'structure at infinity' of the Deligne–Mumford compactification of M_{g,ν}. The boundary D is a normal-crossings divisor, in the stack sense. D_d denotes the normalised codimension-d stratum: points where d local branches of D meet, together with the data of those branches. \tilde D_d → D_d is the principal S_d-covering that orders the d branches.

For a finite ordered set J with a 'codim' function, D_J is the space of flags of strata of type J. Here e_J is the extremal (deepest) element, with codim d = c(e_J). On the previous page, (154) defines H(J) as the set of order-embeddings J → P(I_d)^op compatible with codim (codim = cardinality of the subset), where I_d = {1..d}. Then (155) gives D_J ≅ \tilde D_d ∧^{S_d} H(J), a contracted product: a flag of type J is a point of the deepest stratum plus a choice of subsets of its branches. A codim-compatible embedding J' → J induces D_J → D_{J'} (157).

This page checks that this functoriality can be read off from (155):
- Take x ∈ J' with x ≠ e_J and codim d' < d. The composite (158) D_J → D_{J'} → D_{d'} is the map defined by functoriality from {x} ⊂ J'.
- He compares it with (159) D_J → D_{d,d'} := D_{Δ(d,d')}, where Δ(d,d') is the two-element flag type d > d'.
- Applying (155) to J = Δ(d,d') gives (160) D_{d,d'} ≅ \tilde D_d ∧^{S_d} P_{d'}(I_d). That is, a codim-d point together with a choice of d' of its d branches.
- The evaluation map (161) H(J) → P_{d'}(I_d), h ↦ h(x), is S_d-equivariant. It therefore induces D_J → D_{d,d'} through the contracted products.
- The next page completes the argument: D_{d,d'} → D_{d'} ('forget the other d−d' branches, normalise') factors the composite, giving the commutative square (163).

Purpose: an explicit combinatorial (torsor-theoretic) description of the whole diagram of flag strata of the boundary. It is the 'D-multiplicity' bookkeeping needed for the stratified, tubular-neighbourhood description of M_{g,ν} at infinity.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The requirement d' < d (stated 'car d'<d!') follows from x ≠ e_J together with injectivity and codim-compatibility of the embedding.

Minor gap: the notes only assert that the identification is 'entirely described' by the S_d-torsor. The fact that the stratum map D_{d,d'} → D_{d'} is determined by the torsor data is left to the next page and not proved here.

ideas.what: Normalised self-intersection strata D_d of a normal-crossings divisor, with the S_d-torsor \tilde D_d of orderings of the local branches
ideas.modern_name: normalisation of the d-fold stratum / D^{[d]} with the torsor of local branches (orientation local system ε^d)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (Théorie de Hodge II, 1971); standard in log geometry

ideas.what: Flag strata D_J described as the contracted product \tilde D_d ∧^{S_d} H(J), with H(J) the codim-compatible embeddings of J into subsets of branches; functoriality induced by S_d-equivariant evaluation maps h ↦ h(x)
ideas.modern_name: description of boundary strata of a normal-crossings (toroidal) compactification via the stratification poset / cone complex; dual-graph combinatorics of the boundary of \bar M_{g,n}
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; toroidal embeddings (Kempf–Knudsen–Mumford–Saint-Donat 1973); for \bar M_{g,n}, the stratification by stable graphs (Deligne–Mumford, Knudsen)

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but standard bookkeeping for the strata of a normal-crossings divisor via the S_d-torsor of branch orderings. The equivariance check and commutative square are routine and known in the literature in equivalent forms.
transcription_corrections: 'Π_{d'}(I_d)' in (160) and (161) should read P_{d'}(I_d), the set of d'-element subsets of I_d (Grothendieck's 𝔓-type script P).
In (160), 'D'_d' is \tilde D_d (or D_d^!), the principal S_d-cover; the subscript '(𝔖_d)_{D_d}' means S_d as a constant group over D_d.
Line 3 reads '(< d)' (or '(≠d)'), qualifying the cardinal d' of x.
Before (161) the marginal reads 'avec d' = cod(x)' rather than 'd = card(e_J)'.
'l'homomorphisme' is likely 'l'homomorphisme suivant'; 'ensemble totalement ordonné' is correct for Δ(d,d').
